en.title: Inside NBA Europe's $10bn plan that has football clubs queuing to join
en.summary: The NBA is launching a European basketball league in 2028 with $10 billion investment over a decade, featuring 12 permanent franchises and four temporary members selected through qualifying competition. Multiple European football clubs have submitted offers to join the inaugural season.

en.title: Can hope save the planet? An endangered parrot that is beating the odds can help us find out
en.summary: A new global biodiversity report offers some encouraging findings about nature's health, though recent data showed wildlife populations declined by 73% over 50 years. The report suggests that resilience and hope are important factors in addressing environmental challenges.
